brief: Course creator complete stack 2026 — course platform, community, payments, email, video hosting, support.

slots.tagline: Server-rendered course portal with auth, progress tracking, and dynamic lesson routing.
slots.f1Body: File-based routing scales to hundreds of lessons without performance degradation.
slots.f2Body: Vercel's global CDN serves video and markup from the nearest node instantly.
slots.f3Body: Stream interactive quizzes and comments while keeping bundles lightweight.

slots.tagline: Discussions, issues and wikis keep students collaborating in the open.
slots.f1Body: Q&A lives next to your codebase for searchable context forever.
slots.f2Body: Markdown docs auto-sync with every curriculum update you publish.
slots.f3Body: CI triggers onboarding emails and repo invitations on enrollment.

slots.tagline: Subscriptions, one-time purchases and invoicing with webhook-driven access control.
slots.f1Body: Payment pages convert at industry-leading rates across every currency.
slots.f2Body: Provision course access the moment any payment clears successfully.
slots.f3Body: Sales-tax calculation removes liability from your monthly ledger.

slots.tagline: Visual workflow builder triggers drip sequences, alerts and student re-engagement campaigns.
slots.f1Body: Drag-and-drop nodes replace brittle scripts for complex campaign logic.
slots.f2Body: React to Stripe events, form fills or course milestones instantly.
slots.f3Body: Branch journeys based on tags, progress or purchase history.

slots.tagline: Async video lessons with transcriptions, chapters and built-in viewer analytics.
slots.f1Body: Capture screen and camera without exporting or upload delays.
slots.f2Body: Searchable captions improve accessibility and lesson discoverability.
slots.f3Body: Private links drop into Next.js lessons and Notion hubs.

slots.tagline: Living documentation, FAQ databases and student portals in one unified workspace.
slots.f1Body: Nested pages organize troubleshooting guides and curriculum changelogs.
slots.f2Body: Databases track tickets, feedback and feature requests from enrollment.
slots.f3Body: Notion Q&A surfaces answers across thousands of support docs.

slots.ctaBody: Ship your course platform in days, not months. Clone the template and go live.
